The '''Hand of the Forgotten''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] traded by the [[Keeper of the Scythe]], a [[collector]] in [[Throne of Secrets]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]]) 
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Grim Scythe]], [[dye]]d black.
